components.name: Decision Card
components.description: Claude-style rich card for anything that needs your say-so.
components.html:
Let Barnaby order parts from your suppliersA new key

To order ten pairs of brake pads from Madison for tomorrow's brake job.

A new key needs a click, not a spoken yes.
components.css: .ds-card { max-width: 720px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #D3CCBE; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,45,20,.08), 0 12px 32px -16px rgba(60,45,20,.08); font-family: 'Segoe UI Variable Text','Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif; color: #24211C; } .ds-h { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 18px 0; } .ds-k { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 11px; background: #F1E5C9; color: #87590F; } .ds-h b { display: block; font-size: 17px; } .ds-h small { color: #6A655B; font-size: 13px; } .ds-l { margin: 10px 18px 0 68px; font: 400 16.5px/1.55 'Sitka Text',Constantia,Georgia,serif; } .ds-f { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-top: 16px; padding: 12px 14px 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #E2DDD2; } .ds-f span { margin-right: auto; font-size: 13.5px; color: #6A655B; } .ds-f button { height: 38px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; font: 600 14.5px/1 inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-no { border: 1px solid #D3CCBE; background: #fff; color: #24211C; } .ds-no:hover { background: #ECE8DF; } .ds-yes { border: 0; background: #87590F; color: #fff; } .ds-yes:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); } .ds-f button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A8772A; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: Barnaby is an AI assistant, so his display looks like the AI apps people already use: the Claude and Codex desktop apps. One centred column for the conversation, his work inline as quiet grey lines, rich cards when he needs your say-so, a big rounded composer and a side panel where state lives. What makes it his: his words in an upright reading serif, a warm ground, brass as the one brand colour, and his own mark, a counter bell wearing a bow tie.
keyCharacteristics: One 720px column where his words, his work and the cards appear in the order they happened.
His work as collapsed plain-words lines; one live line while he works, with his mark at work and a timer.
Barnaby speaks in a serif; the interface and your words are in a sans.
Warm ivory or warm charcoal; brass for the mark, the working animation, the decision and focus, and nothing else.
Claude-style rich cards for every ask: a plain title, the facts, the change by its counts, a clear yes and no.
A mark with one silhouette and one inner sign, readable at 16px, with its own animation.

rules.name: The One Brass Rule
rules.body: Brass is his mark, his working animation, the decision you make, Hold to talk and focus. Nothing else is brass. If it shows up as decoration, it comes out.

rules.name: The Never-Colour-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state carries an icon and a word: a tick and "You said yes", a key and "Asks first", a no-entry sign and "Kept shut".

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Barnaby speaks in the serif; everything you operate is in the sans. Never set a control, a label or your own words in the serif, and never set his reply in the sans.

dos: Do keep the work inline and collapsed in plain words; one live line while he works; the technical record two clicks down.
Do set his words in the serif and everything you operate in the sans.
Do keep every yes and no in the thread, naming the thing, before the work it allowed.
Do keep the decision reachable: the card's footer docks while the card runs past the fold.
Do say how a card may be answered: a spoken yes for ordinary changes, a click for keys, shortcuts and new pieces.
Do keep light the default for the shop, with dark one switch away (?theme=dark or the bar's switch, remembered).
Do honour reduced motion (everything still) and keep transitions at 150–220ms.
donts: Don't bring back a separate trace column, a monospace log, italic serif, dark navy, or bubbles on both sides.
Don't add a second brand colour, gradients, glows or glass; brass is the only accent.
Don't animate anything but his mark on the live line and the level bars while listening.
Don't redraw the mark: no outline version, no tie without the cut-out, no ring arcs when he is idle.
Don't put a kicker above a heading or a capsule around a state word.
Don't promise what the app can't do: there is no way to take a key back yet, so no card says there is.
Don't call Barnaby's 3 new tests Theo's: "Theo's 19 checks still pass, and so do the 3 new ones."
